title: Stockholm photographs and a Johnny Blowers letter
summary: Photos taken in Stockholm and a letter from Johnny Blowers about her work with the Giants of Jazz.

There's a couple in Stockholm, 'When I Get There' Olga (Inaudible) and Olē Johnson, he takes an awful lot of pictures. I've got so many pictures upstairs you wouldn't even believe it, some taken, especially in Stockholm because they took a lot of them.

Maxine Sullivan received a letter from Johnny Blowers, (phonetic spelling), it says, "To Whom It May Concern: Maxine Sullivan for the last three years has thrilled thousands of people here on Long Island with Johnny Blowers and the (Inaudible) of jazz. Your songs and your general ways have caused everyone to fall in love with you. I personally can think of no other way to call you except "The Great Lady of Song." (Very appropriate) May your House (sic-Jazz) That Jack Built become the highest and best that ever happened. Wishing all of you continued success,

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Johnny Blowers and all the Giants of Jazz." Signed Johnny Blowers.
And that's something you just received.
Yeah, I just got that this morning. I was out in Old Westbury Gardens last week and we played out there. Each year for the last three years I've been going out there.
